sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic with a generator (E, r) and one or two
resistors R₁, R₂ (series switch to combine). Sliders: E, r, R₁, R₂.
Ammeter reads I. Formula strip: I = E / (r + R_total). Live
substitution — the formula evaluates numerically as sliders move.
Experiment: given an E and required I, pick R_total. Evaluate:
ammeter hidden; student computes I mentally from Pouillet and enters
a numeric value. Wrinkle: analytic close of the operating-point
exercise; drills the "series = sum of resistances including internal"
gotcha.
